name: SemanticHearing

repository_license.attribution_action: Retain the MIT notice in this folder and preserve it with any distributed substantial copy.

browser_candidate_reason: The model exposes causal state and target conditioning, but the checked-in code is PyTorch training code for binaural microphone input. No browser export, browser-compatible preprocessing, or license-cleared checkpoint is included.

curated_files.purpose: Core causal dilated-convolution encoder, causal transformer decoder, target-conditioned mask generator, streaming state buffers, and waveform encoder/decoder.
curated_files.expected_audioshield_destination: A future isolated model adapter or offline export harness; no production destination was created.
curated_files.modification_required: Wrap the stateful forward path with explicit tensor inputs/outputs, replace or package the SpeechBrain positional encoding dependency, define fixed browser tensor shapes, and validate ONNX/WebGPU operator support.

curated_files.purpose: Two-channel wrapper: binaural input/output convolutions, label embedding, streaming prediction, checkpoint loading, and spatial evaluation hooks.
curated_files.expected_audioshield_destination: A future separator adapter after browser export; not a drop-in MV3 module.
curated_files.modification_required: Remove training/evaluation-only imports, replace dictionary/optional-state outputs with an explicit inference ABI, and decide how normal browser stereo maps to the model's binaural training domain.

curated_files.purpose: Canonical 20-label ordering used to build the model's multi-hot conditioning vector.
curated_files.expected_audioshield_destination: A future label-map test/adapter, not a runtime dataset import.
curated_files.modification_required: Extract only the ordered label map into a browser-safe data contract and reconcile it with AudioShield's detector vocabulary.

curated_files.purpose: Reproducible architecture and dataset configuration: 44.1 kHz, L=32, model_dim=256, 10 causal encoder layers, 13-frame decoder context/chunk, and 20 labels.
curated_files.modification_required: Separate runtime model parameters from training paths and verify latency/memory at the target browser sample rate.

curated_files.purpose: Required upstream attribution and license text.

inspected_not_copied.reason: Its model/checkpoint and dataset URLs are captured below; the prose is summarized in USEFUL_COMPONENTS.md.
Training-only Scaper/SOFA/HRTF synthesis and normalization; useful for domain-gap analysis but not browser runtime.
Room/HRTF simulation for dataset generation; it does not process browser tab audio.
Binaural ITD/ILD/DOA evaluation utilities; not required for the target-selective attenuation path.
Offline checkpoint evaluation and profiling orchestration; no browser inference contract.

external_artifacts.verification: The GitHub repository license is MIT, but neither README.md nor the hosted artifact response provides an explicit license covering this checkpoint.
external_artifacts.action: Do not download, vendor, redistribute, or use for an AudioShield release until the checkpoint owner supplies explicit terms.

external_artifacts.verification: The repository points to the hosted archive but does not provide an explicit dataset license in the checked-in materials.
external_artifacts.action: Not part of the intake; obtain and clear component datasets independently before training or redistribution.

verification.reason_export_test_not_run: The clone does not include weights; this environment lacks the repository's speechbrain, torchaudio, torchmetrics, and onnx dependencies, so a meaningful export test would require installing and selecting additional components.
